title: Former treasurer of youth baseball league charged with embezzling about $76,000
summary: A West Jordan woman is accused of buying numerous products from Amazon and Walmart not approved by the West Jordan Copper Hills Baseball League.

title: Teenage girl killed in off-highway vehicle crash in Garden City
summary: A 17-year-old girl was killed Friday when the off-highway vehicle she was riding on overturned in Garden City, according to police.
